scope: Monitor and Diagnostics only; 180 seconds x 3 repetitions per candidate/dataset/mode, plus 30-second warmup per run
previous_30_minute_lifecycle_runs: Preserved unchanged in measurements/; not repeated in this dataset

execution_requests.scope: Temporary while this measurement runner is active; no power-plan or lock-policy changes

limitations: Serial visible windows; foreground focus, occlusion, desktop activity and thermal/clock behavior uncontrolled.
No native builds, dependency installs, local test suites or plotting were run during this measurement; lightweight status/data reads and document preparation continued.
CPU includes the common worker and is normalized to one logical core, not the total machine.
Private bytes and working set are sampled maxima, not instantaneous OS peaks; GPU memory is excluded.
Frame age measures producer capture to GUI intake, not actual present or physical input response.
Diagnostics has no preview intake during measurement; raw zero frame-age fields are sentinels, not measured zero latency.
Diagnostics reference_requests is cumulative and includes warmup; topology_builds/value_update_cycles are warmup-reset counters.
NDI, Scenario Runtime, physical input, IME, actual DPI transitions and score/state-to-display latency remain unverified.
